claim_assertions.beginning_year_margin_basis_matches_regi: The annual margin and regional revenue reconciliations use the same currency comparison basis.
claim_assertions.target_includes_acquisition_expense: The FY2026 target operating margin already includes the stated acquisition expenses.
claim_assertions.exact_average_member_revenue_identified: The Q4 paid-membership milestone identifies an exact annual average-member revenue denominator.

definitions.regional_currency: Use the detailed thousand-dollar Q4 appendix, adding signed currency and hedging-exclusion adjustments. Prior growth denominator also excludes hedging.
definitions.annual_currency_margin: Recompute revenue and expense on the beginning-year FX basis, with margin-change basis points equal to adjusted less reported margin.
definitions.forecast_bounds: FY2026 forecasts are not actuals. Implied revenue and operating growth use reported FY2025 actuals. The 31.5 percent target already includes the acquisition expense, so do not add it again.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
